finding: 30m cross-pair edge is carried by POOLED TRAINING on base multi-TF features, NOT cross-pair/lead-lag/factor features

subsumes.I-Aa_antisymmetric_leadlag: ll_ lead-lag features carry only 2.1% gain AND are already GBM inputs; Aa is a linear combo of them -> cannot beat incumbent (Tier-1 subsumption)
subsumes.I-ipca_instrumented_betas: cross-pair factor channel carries 2.0% gain; IPCA refines that channel -> cannot move the pooled-base-feature edge (Tier-1 subsumption)

implication: the lever that produced the edge is POOLING (7-pair rows -> more data + cross-pair regularization of base features, esp rescuing DOWN), not the xpof feature block. Discovery R2 should probe pooling breadth/scheme, not factor refinements.
